explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of all things and the highest authority over heaven and earth.
Death has ended for believers, so that their true life is now hidden with Christ in God.
Jesus of Nazareth, the Son of God, who died for humanity's sins and rose again to give eternal life.
Bad actions or thoughts that go against God's will, which believers should avoid in their new life.
The highest commandment to love others unconditionally and be a binding force for the community.
An inner calm and harmony that God gives to the heart, even when external circumstances are difficult.
An attitude where one acknowledges God's grace by praising him in all situations.
The reciprocal communication between man and God, characterized by thanksgiving and prayer for others.
